India Telecommunications Authority is the telecom authority. Importer shall obtain Radio Authorization before shipment. Radio Authorization requires Technical Certificate. Importer shall obtain High Band Radio Authorization before shipment. High Band Radio Authorization requires Technical Certificate. Technical Certificate is a certificate issued by the supplier and accepted as PDF. WPC is Wireless Planning and Coordination. WPC Equipment Type Approval entry ETA. India Filing Service is publicly accessible at https://dot.gov.in/service for the importer to file; no login required. Use https://dot.gov.in/contact for electronics verification.
